en: The image shows a colorized photograph of a historical railway station with a wooden building featuring a tower and steep roof. There are people gathered outside the station, and a steam locomotive with attached cars is visible on the right. In the foreground, there are train cars loaded with logs. The platform and tracks are clearly visible, and the setting suggests an event or a busy day at the station. The text on the card is in Swedish, and there is handwriting at the bottom.
